description: Designs the inbound REST adapter for an already-modeled use case — endpoints, DTOs, status codes, error map, pagination, idempotency, API versioning, inbound admission, and OpenAPI — into the `30-rest.md` partial. Use when the request involves exposing a use case via HTTP, designing an endpoint or controller, deciding status and error body, paginating a collection, applying `Idempotency-Key`, introducing a `/v2` or deprecating and retiring an API version, a rate limit or quota per client, a concurrency cap, a 429, or fixing the OpenAPI contract. Piece of the `/new-feature` pipeline: requires `10-domain.md` in the given folder and stops without it.
